name: Text Converter
description: Convert text between letter cases and naming conventions.

hints.input: Splitting treats every non-alphanumeric character as a separator, so Chinese text is split character by character.
hints.style: Every style has a fixed separator and casing rule.
hints.separator: With "Custom separator" the words are joined by the character you provide; their casing is left untouched.
hints.output: The result shows the converted text together with the words that were detected, so you can check the splitting.

faq.a: Only separators split words; runs of capital letters stay together, so HTTPServer is a single word. Spell out the separator to split it.

faq.q: Is Chinese text split into words?
faq.a: No. Every non-alphanumeric character is a separator, so Chinese is split per character; there is no linguistic word segmentation.

faq.q: How does the custom separator differ from a fixed style?
faq.a: A fixed style brings its own separator and casing rule; the custom separator only joins the words with the character you typed and does not change their case.
